mission: Produce a credible, integrated research program to discover a new solid-state electrolyte for lithium-metal batteries (target: room-temperature ionic conductivity above 10 mS/cm, electrochemical window above 4.5 V, stable against Li metal, made from earth-abundant elements). The final deliverable for M0 must contain: ranked candidate chemistries with mechanistic rationale; a computational screening pipeline; synthesis and characterization plans; three decisive experiments with go/no-go criteria; a risk register; and a 12-month timeline. Every claim should state its evidence or its uncertainty.
